title: Count with a for loop
explanation:
A for loop starts with an initial value and checks its condition
before each pass. The update runs after each pass.

questions.hint: Check when the loop first needs to stop.

questions.prompt: Which update lets this while loop stop?
questions.hint: The condition must eventually become false. How should i change?

options.feedback: Adding 1 each pass lets i reach 3, so the loop stops.
i moves away from 3, so the loop never stops.
i stays at 0, so the loop never stops.
